GLDIO.title: Diorama
GLDIO.hint: The battle map as a painted 3D diorama: height-painted ground under the map art, walls and doors in 3D, tokens as paper standees. Height is mechanical: it blocks sight and light on the 2D canvas too, moves tokens up and down, stops walking at cliffs and shows cover and falls. Foundry v14, square grids.
GLDIO.settings.rules.name: Height rules
GLDIO.settings.rules.hint: Painted height blocks sight and light, sets token elevation, stops walking at cliffs and feeds cover. Off: the terrain is only a look.
GLDIO.settings.stepHeight.name: Step height
GLDIO.settings.stepHeight.hint: The highest rise a creature walks up without climbing, in scene distance units. A bigger drop is marked as a fall.
GLDIO.settings.wallHeight.name: Wall height
GLDIO.settings.wallHeight.hint: Default height of a wall above the ground it stands on, in scene distance units. A Wall Height flag on a wall wins.
GLDIO.settings.wallMaterial.name: Default wall material
GLDIO.settings.wallMaterial.hint: How walls look in 3D unless a wall has its own material in the terrain editor.
GLDIO.settings.cutout.name: Cut out portrait backgrounds
GLDIO.settings.cutout.hint: Try to remove the plain background behind portrait art so standees read as die-cut figures.
GLDIO.settings.tiltShift.name: Tilt-shift blur
GLDIO.settings.tiltShift.hint: Blur the top and bottom of the 3D view, like a photo of a model.
GLDIO.settings.grid.name: Grid in the 3D view
GLDIO.settings.grid.hint: Draw the scene's square grid on the 3D ground, in the scene's grid colour.
GLDIO.settings.effects.name: Conditions and effects in the 3D view
GLDIO.settings.effects.hint: Halo puts the icons in a ring along the front of each figure's base, like PF2e Effects Halo. Over the head stacks them on the name plate.
GLDIO.settings.yawSnap.name: 3D camera rotation step
GLDIO.settings.yawSnap.hint: How far the 3D camera turns with each rotate. 90° keeps it on the four diagonal views.
GLDIO.settings.invite.name: When the GM opens the 3D view
GLDIO.settings.invite.hint: What happens on this client when the GM opens the 3D view on the scene you are on.
GLDIO.settings.follow.name: Follow the current combatant
GLDIO.settings.follow.hint: In the 3D view, move the camera to whoever's turn it is.
GLDIO.settings.quality.name: 3D quality
GLDIO.settings.quality.hint: How much detail the 3D view draws on this computer. The options below can override single parts of it.
GLDIO.settings.adaptive.name: Adapt to frame rate
GLDIO.settings.adaptive.hint: When the frame rate drops, turn detail down for a while, then back up. Off keeps exactly what you chose.
GLDIO.settings.shadows.name: Shadows
GLDIO.settings.ao.name: Ambient occlusion
GLDIO.settings.ao.hint: Soft shade at the foot of cliffs and in corners.
GLDIO.settings.water.name: Water
GLDIO.settings.water.hint: Full water bends what lies under it and has caustics, glints, shore waves and falls. Simple is a flat tinted surface.
GLDIO.settings.detail.name: Surface detail
GLDIO.settings.detail.hint: Brick and rock relief on cliffs and props, and foliage that sways in the wind.
GLDIO.settings.weatherFx.name: Weather effects
GLDIO.settings.weatherFx.hint: Rain, snow, falling leaves, embers and other particles the scene's weather calls for.
GLDIO.settings.atmosphere.name: Atmosphere
GLDIO.settings.atmosphere.hint: Fog, haze, light shafts and cloud shadows.
GLDIO.settings.lightFx.name: Living light
GLDIO.settings.lightFx.hint: Torches and fires flicker, burn with a small flame and rising embers, and the lights near a figure shade it and throw its shadow. Off keeps every light steady.
GLDIO.settings.fogStyle.name: Fog of war
GLDIO.settings.fogStyle.hint: How places nobody has seen yet look. Clouds lays a slowly drifting bank of cloud over them and a thin mist over places seen before. Flat leaves them dark.
GLDIO.settings.renderScale.name: Resolution
GLDIO.settings.renderScale.hint: Share of your screen's pixels the 3D view draws. Lower is faster and softer.
GLDIO.settings.fps.name: Frame rate limit
GLDIO.settings.fps.hint: The most frames a second the 3D view draws while something moves. It draws nothing while the board is still.
GLDIO.settings.dayNight.name: Time of day lighting
GLDIO.settings.dayNight.hint: Light the 3D view for the scene's time of day. Off always draws clear midday light, which is easiest to read.
GLDIO.settings.grade.name: Colour grade
GLDIO.settings.grade.hint: A light film grade over the 3D view. Off shows the map's colours as painted.
GLDIO.settings.gridStrength.name: Grid strength
GLDIO.settings.gridStrength.hint: How strongly the square grid is drawn on the 3D ground, when it is on.
GLDIO.settings.reach.name: Movement range
GLDIO.settings.reach.hint: Shade the squares a token can reach in one, two and three Strides (PF2e), counting walls, difficult terrain and cliffs.
GLDIO.settings.tokenLife.name: Token animation
GLDIO.settings.tokenLife.hint: Figures hop square by square, fall off ledges, kick up a little dust where they land, and flyers drift on their stands. Off: figures slide with a plain bounce and stand still, and the view can rest when nothing else moves.
GLDIO.settings.tactics.name: Sight and fall readouts
GLDIO.settings.tactics.hint: With one of your tokens selected, hovering or targeting another draws the line of sight between them, broken where ground or a wall stops it, with the cover and the 3D distance. While you move, a drop off a ledge shows its height and falling damage. Shown only, never applied.
GLDIO.settings.areaVolumes.name: Spell areas in 3D
GLDIO.settings.areaVolumes.hint: Bursts stand up as domes, cones as wedges, emanations as shells and lines as raised slabs, cut to the squares they cover and sitting on the ground under them. Off leaves only the highlighted squares.
GLDIO.settings.envSource.name: Time of day comes from
GLDIO.settings.envSource.hint: Where each scene's time of day is read from. A scene can still set its own in its environment.
GLDIO.settings.weatherSource.name: Weather comes from
GLDIO.settings.weatherSource.hint: Where each scene's weather is read from. The calendar choice follows the Weather feature when it is on.
GLDIO.settings.propsBlock.name: Solid props block
GLDIO.settings.propsBlock.hint: Props marked solid stop movement and block sight and cover like raised ground. Off makes every prop scenery.
GLDIO.controls.viewOn: 3D view: on. Press to go back to the 2D map
GLDIO.keys.toggleHint: Open or close the Diorama view of the current scene.
GLDIO.keys.peekHint: Open or close a small window onto the live 2D canvas while the 3D view is open.
GLDIO.graphics.title: 3D view graphics
GLDIO.graphics.hint: These are for this computer only. Changes show at once.
GLDIO.graphics.readout.title: What the view costs now
GLDIO.view.summoned: Players with the 3D view open are moving to your camera.
GLDIO.peek.title: 2D map
GLDIO.view.notSetUpHint: This scene's terrain is not set up yet, so the 3D ground is flat. Edit terrain, in the 3D view's tools, raises it.
GLDIO.stream.heading: Board view
GLDIO.stream.hint: What the capture shows. It switches at once; when the GM next opens the 3D view, the capture follows them in.
GLDIO.stream.hintOffAir: Start the stream to switch the capture between the 2D map and the 3D view.
GLDIO.stream.hintUnsupported: The capture's scene cannot be shown in 3D: it needs a square grid, and the GM may have turned 3D off for it.
GLDIO.view.noScene: There is no scene to show in 3D.
GLDIO.view.unsupported: The 3D view needs a square grid.
GLDIO.view.off: The GM turned the 3D view off for this scene.
GLDIO.view.failed: The 3D view could not open. The console has the details.
GLDIO.editor.failed: The terrain editor could not open. The console has the details.
GLDIO.hud.standeeFailed: The standee settings could not open. The console has the details.
GLDIO.move.stopped: The move stopped short. Something on the way blocks it.
GLDIO.move.anyway: You can still set it down here
GLDIO.move.offBoard: Off the map: it goes back where it was
GLDIO.tactics.fallWater: Counts {reduction} {units} shorter if the water is that deep, else {dry} bludgeoning
GLDIO.standee.title: Standee: {name}
GLDIO.standee.denied: Only the actor's owners and the GM can change its standee.
GLDIO.standee.failed: The standee could not be saved.
GLDIO.standee.art.head: Art
GLDIO.standee.art.scope: Saved on the actor: every token of it, on any scene and for everyone at the table, stands this art.
GLDIO.standee.art.tainted: This art can't be read from another server, so the 3D view will stand a plain figure in its place.
GLDIO.standee.marks.head: Head and feet
GLDIO.standee.marks.hint: Drag the lines to the top of the head and the soles of the feet. That span is the creature's height. Art below the feet is cut off; art above the head still shows.
GLDIO.standee.marks.auto: Auto: the whole figure is the height
GLDIO.standee.marks.readout: Head at {top}%, feet at {bottom}% of the art
GLDIO.standee.height.head: Height
GLDIO.standee.height.label: Creature height
GLDIO.standee.height.empty: Empty: automatic from the creature's size.
